name: @tol/evidence
description: Provenance, freshness classes (FRESH/AGING/STALE/UNKNOWN) and readiness rules (the spec, p.16) shared by Passport (P6) and Capacity (P8) — both need the same staleness/blocker/warning machinery. earlier: real content — computeReadiness() (Passport's ReadinessResult engine) and classifyCapacityFreshness() (replacing the client-supplied CapacityProfile.freshnessClass with a real deterministic classifier). Zero runtime dependencies, same discipline as @tol/domain/@tol/authz/@tol/crypto/@tol/attribution. Pure, zero-DB, zero-clock (every function takes an explicit reference time — never reads Date.now() internally).
